up: Retrieve up to 200 human metabolism records. Return the canonical SMILES of the substrate (alias as substrate_structure), the substrate compound name (alias as substrate_name), the parent drug compound name (alias as parent_name), the metabolic conversion (alias as met_conversion), the pathway key (alias as pathway), and the enzyme name (alias as enzyme). Join the metabolism table with compound_records twice: first on substrate_record_id to retrieve the substrate compound name, and second on drug_record_id to retrieve the parent compound name. Join compound_structures on the substrate's molregno to get the canonical SMILES. Filter where organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Apply a LIMIT of 200.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure, sub_rec.compound_name AS substrate_name, drug_rec.compound_name AS parent_name, m.met_conversion AS met_conversion, m.pathway_key AS pathway, m.enzyme_name AS enzyme FROM metabolism m JOIN compound_records sub_rec ON m.substrate_record_id = sub_rec.record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON sub_rec.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records drug_rec ON m.drug_record_id = drug_rec.record_id WHERE m.organism = 'Homo sapiens' LIMIT 200
